Name: SOCRadar MSSP
Author: SOCRadar - integration@socradar.io
Description: The [SOCRadar MSSP](https://socradar.io/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel monitors multiple SOCRadar Company IDs from a single Microsoft Sentinel deployment. Import multi-company alarms as incidents tagged per company, sync closed incidents back to the matching SOCRadar account with classification mapping. For single-customer deployments, use the SOCRadar solution instead.
WorkbookBladeDescription: This solution installs a workbook to visualize SOCRadar alarm data across multiple companies imported into Microsoft Sentinel.
HuntingQueryBladeDescription: This solution installs hunting queries to help investigate SOCRadar alarm data across companies in Microsoft Sentinel.
AnalyticalRuleBladeDescription: This solution installs analytic rule templates to detect critical SOCRadar alarms, alarm volume anomalies, and sync failures — all grouped by company.
PlaybooksBladeDescription: This solution installs playbooks to automate multi-company alarm import and sync between SOCRadar and Microsoft Sentinel.
WorkbookDescription: SOCRadar MSSP Dashboard provides per-company visibility into alarms imported from SOCRadar, alarm trends across the MSSP portfolio, severity distribution, and audit logs.
PlaybookDescription: Imports SOCRadar alarms as Microsoft Sentinel incidents tagged per company, with deduplication, pagination, and per-company error isolation. Provisions the Data Collection Endpoint, custom log tables (SOCRadar_MSSP_Alarms_CL and SOCRadar_MSSP_AuditLog_CL) and Data Collection Rules required for alarm storage and audit logging.
Syncs closed Microsoft Sentinel incidents back to the matching SOCRadar company with classification mapping.
